card.name: Hyphen inside compound proper names
card.fires_on: A hyphen (or the letter right after it) inside a hyphenated foreign proper name, such as Villa-Lobos or Capitale-Nationale, or the end of Agence France-Presse. Seen in names of places, people, organizations and projects in general web text.

modes.label: Hyphen in compound names
modes.description: The hyphen or the first letter after it in a hyphenated place, person or project name.
modes.example: Villa<<-L>>obos was made director of music education

modes.label: End of France-Presse
modes.description: The final piece of the news agency name Agence France-Presse.
modes.example: copyright Agence France-P<<resse>>, United Press International

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of hyphenated foreign names, like Villa-Lobos or Agence France-Presse.
